{{incomplete|2=Catalogue numbers}} The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the first season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, ''[[S01|Indigo League]]'', in {{pmin|the United Kingdom}}. DVD releases are for {{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 2}}, {{wp|Blu-ray}} releases are for {{wp|Blu-ray Region Code|Blu-ray Region B}}, and all releases are {{wp|PAL}}. In Region 2 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to standard [[season]]s (in the same way as on [[Pokémon.com]]), rather than by [[Viz Media]] season (as seen in Region 1 releases). ==Single releases== ===VHS=== The ''Indigo League'' single releases were released by {{wp|Warner Bros.}} in the United Kingdom on VHS. Only the first 33 episodes of ''Indigo League'' have been released on VHS in the United Kingdom. A folded paper insert was included with each cassette detailing how to join the Pokémon Collector Club, alongside a numbered cut out token that could be sent away in exchange for a selection of different gifts. A coupon was also included for £1 off the next purchase of a Pokémon VHS at participating retailers. {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Kanto}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Kanto}}; {{roundy|10px}}" ! ''[[EP039|Pikachu’s Goodbye]]'' | April 15, 2019 |} ==Double releases== [[File:Thunder Shock Seaside Pikachu UK VHS.png|thumb|200px|Thunder Shock! / Seaside Pikachu]] Pokémon Volumes 5 & 6: Thunder Shock! / Seaside Pikachu is a dual VHS set that was released in the United Kingdom by {{wp|Warner Bros.}} on October 1, 2001 with the catalogue number S037417. It consists of two VHS tapes in a single case. {{-}} ==Season 1 disc set== {{incomplete|section|needs=Disc divisions}} [[File:Indigo League DVD UK.png|thumb|DVD set cover]] [[File:Indigo League BR UK.png|thumb|Blu-ray set cover]] The Season 1 disc set was released on DVD and Blu-ray by {{wp|Manga Entertainment}} in the United Kingdom on October 30, 2017. Both sets contain a total of 52 episodes. The DVD set contains eight discs across 2 volumes, while the Blu-ray set contains five discs in one volume. Its discs are designed to resemble a {{i|Poké Ball}}. The set doesn't include English closed captioning. ===Contents=== Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself. ====DVD==== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Kanto}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Kanto}}; {{roundy|10px}}" !
